titulo: Starbucks (Sep 2025): $2.77 billion in dividends, about 900 jobs to be eliminated. The math, done.
caption:
From the archive: Sep 2025. Not today's news.
Starbucks, Sep 25, 2025 (Brian Niccol, chairman and CEO): "these decisions impact our partners and their families, and we did not make them lightly"
Starbucks' chairman and CEO wrote to partners on Sept. 25, 2025, in an SEC 8-K letter. It said the company would eliminate approximately 900 non-retail partner roles. The dividend figure is from its fiscal 2025 10-K.

Same year: $2.77 billion in dividends, fiscal 2025, company-wide. $2,771.4 million of cash dividends paid in fiscal 2025, company-wide; the same table shows no stock repurchases in fiscal 2025 (a dash), against $1,266.7 million the year before.
The math: $2.77 billion in dividends (2025) ÷ about 900 job cuts = about $3.07 million in dividends per non-retail job cut.
The facts: $2.77 billion in dividends, fiscal 2025, company-wide (Starbucks 2025 10-K (SEC), Nov 14, 2025). about 900 jobs to be eliminated (Starbucks 8-K letter (SEC), Sep 25, 2025). The $2.77 billion is cash dividends paid in fiscal 2025 (ended Sep 28, 2025), per the 10-K. Starbucks repurchased no stock that year. The 900 counts non-retail partner roles only; the same letter also says it will close many open positions, which we do not count.

We did not make them lightly. Here is the dividend column. (Our take.)

Send this to someone who has been through a round of cuts.

Sources: Starbucks 8-K letter (SEC), Sep 25, 2025; Starbucks 2025 10-K (SEC), Nov 14, 2025.

Swipe: the sentence, the number, the math, our take.

Link in bio.
